ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the types of fraud being committed and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money is being lost to Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on a critical issue affecting Minnesota's most vulnerable populations. I recommend using data analysis and investigative reporting techniques to uncover the scope of the problem and identify key players.
